remarks: Welcome home to this charming and beautifully updated townhome tucked inside a quiet complex in the heart of Glenbrook. Filled with natural light and warm, inviting spaces, this 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers the ideal combination of modern updates and comfortable everyday living. The open main level creates an effortless flow for entertaining, while the renovated eat-in kitchen features Quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and sliders to a private patio perfect for morning coffee or summer evenings outdoors. Upstairs, two generously sized bedrooms with hardwood floors and ample closet space provide peaceful retreats, complemented by a stunning updated full bath with timeless tile finishes. The finished lower level adds valuable space for a den, office, gym, or playroom and includes a locked storage area. Two reserved parking spaces are conveniently located directly outside the unit. Set within a quiet 10-unit complex just moments from Metro North, downtown Stamford, shopping, dining, and major commuter routes, this home delivers the comfort, convenience, and lifestyle today's buyers are looking for.
